role.description: The primary identity or occupation of the persona, e.g., 'senior backend engineer'.

traits.description: Key personality traits or characteristics, e.g., ['patient', 'logical', 'curious'].

dialogue_behavior.description: How the persona behaves in conversations, e.g., 'asks clarifying questions before answering'.

name.description: Optional display name for the persona.

quirks.description: Small, distinctive behaviors or habits that make the persona unique.

scenario_tags.description: Optional tags for scenario context, e.g., 'job interview', 'fantasy RPG'.

llm_prompt_injection.description: Extra instruction or behavioral override to inject into the persona's prompt.
